entities.name: Fpg P75402
observations: Exact 277-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt P75402, annotated as formamidopyrimidine-DNA glycosylase from Mycoplasmoides pneumoniae.
Annotated for base-excision repair: recognizes/removes damaged bases, with preference for oxidized purines including 8-oxoG; also has AP lyase activity.
Reference annotation reports one Zn2+ ion per subunit.
Pfam scan detects Fapy_DNA_glyco (PF01149; residues 1–117) and H2TH (PF06831; residues 135–226).
Sequence-derived estimates: 31,854 Da; theoretical pI 9.40; GRAVY −0.419.

entities.name: Zn2+ CHEBI:29105
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference annotation reports one zinc ion bound per Fpg subunit.

entities.name: Base excision repair
observations: Fpg participates in base-excision repair by removing damaged DNA bases; it also has AP lyase activity that nicks DNA by beta-delta elimination.
